description:
Hushfeed v0.61.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

A large release. TikTok 47.1.3 is supported alongside 47.0.3, and every fix made since 0.60.0 is in it.

* TikTok 47.1.3 works (#33). Every patch applies to both versions, and Morphe Manager lists both.
* Save media on a comment sticker reads TikTok's own sticker data, so it keeps working from one TikTok version to the next. The button also lightens while you hold it, like TikTok's Share and Save beside it.
* Copy comments without username works from the comment sheet's own menu again.
* On a foldable with the split comment view, folding or unfolding no longer jumps to another video when Hide seen videos is on (#26).
* Camera and microphone indicator shows on TikTok's camera screen, with a green square for the camera and an orange diamond for the microphone.
* Hide Play Store update offer is a new optional patch.
* After an update, a What's new row at the top of Hushfeed's settings opens the changelog. The settings screens had a long polish pass too.

The changelog has the full list.

## Checked

* The full test gate (2,076 runtime tests, the patch tests and both Android lint checks) passed on the commit before this release. The one change after it, the Save media press, passed its own tests.
* All 96 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and to 47.1.3 with this exact bundle, with no manifest changes. The release receipt attached here has each version's verdicts. Use 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 when patching.
* This exact bundle was installed on a Galaxy S25 running TikTok 47.1.3, and TikTok started with no crash. On the same phone, the build just before it saved an animated comment sticker through Save media, and Hook status found all 34 areas with nothing missing.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source in Manager to update. Keep the manager's existing signing key.
